source_provider: Google Search Console Search Analytics API
property_scope: URL-prefix property; some tools are independently hosted under this hostname
date_note: Search Console finalized web search reporting dates; not GA4 session dates

page_breakdown.aggregation_note: Per-page Search Console clicks may not sum to the property-level clicks. Each set has a different aggregation level and is not a complete site page report.

limits: Click means interaction with a Google web search result, not a unique person, task success or app adoption.
The report covers the original verified URL-prefix property. It does not include other domains such as koreaves.com, spoonie.kr or spaceatlasedu.org.
Search Console's property and page aggregations may differ; do not subtract the displayed page counts from the property total to infer the remainder.
This is first-party private-property data, not a third-party editorial acceptance, public independent audit, or human testimonial.
Google Search Console and GA4 measure different things; their reports must not be combined as a conversion funnel without a matched definition.
data_access: The originating GSC property is private; published summary permits provenance review, not independent reproduction without owner access.
privacy: Only aggregate non-identifying counts and original public page paths are published; no searcher or session identifiers.
